Available Summer 2024 · Student Property · Great Location

My Property Box are delighted to offer to the market a four double bedroom maisonette located within the ever popular Jesmond Vale, with access to a good variety of local shops whilst being on the edge of Jesmond Dene, a 42 acre parkland. Bus and road links provide excellent access into the city centre and onto the central motorway. Accommodation briefly comprises of four bedrooms, living room, fitted kitchen and two bathrooms. On street permit parking available.
